subject: Earlier Dragon, ABS-like, 8K Standard and Fast results from PRINTS.md
body:
Earlier resin results from PRINTS.md, as Logan asked (all at 30 um unless stated; 'Brian' = the GM who reviews every print).

DRAGON RESIN DURABLE GREY - the baseline. 2.8 s normal, 27 s bottom, 5 bottom layers, every plate from P2609-01 (2026-09-07) to P2610-05 (2026-10-06); about 38 plates. Gutaki/Scylla failures raised exposure to 2.9 s and 3.0 s with no effect - those were support/island problems, not exposure. Resin-related evidence: Seoni (P0070) printed very well on P2610-02, narrow staff included. Horned Dragon set (body, rocks, wings) is approved by Brian and primed. Graveknight reprint P2610-05 in Dragon kept its sword; the first print (P2610-00) sheared it off - see ABS-like below. Brian's rejections were support damage (Athamaru A/B), support scarring (Scylla body) and scale (elementals too small) - none was a toughness complaint.

ELEGOO ABS-LIKE 3.0 - used for the August release and extras (P2608-00/-01/-02, legacy plates without settings; P2608-01 logged 1.9 s, 27 s bottom, 4 bottom layers). The Graveknight's sword sheared off in this resin (Logan, 2026-10-07: 'more brittle') - the only recorded breakage that Logan attributes to a resin. Caveat: P2610-00's resin was set from 'August prints used it', not from a file.

ELEGOO 8K STANDARD GRAY / 'SPACE GREY 8K STANDARD' - early September plates P2609-04/-05 at 1.5 s and the 6x 50 mm bases P2609-07 at 1.9 s; recent plates P2610-08/-09/-10 at 1.9 s, 27 s bottom, 4 bottom layers (profile name as the file gives it). Legacy April-July plates are the same resin, per Logan. No breakage recorded on it. P2610-08 Air/Fire elementals were reprinted at 32 mm heroic size in it.

SIRAYA TECH FAST GRAY - two plates:
- P2610-06 (2026-10-07): Dhampirs A, B, C. File says 1.8 s, 27 s bottom, 2 bottom layers. Printed, cleaned, cured; minor support nubs left on the cloaks.
- P2610-07 (2026-10-07): Sajan, Seoni, Jirelle, the SAME slice as the Dragon plate P2610-02 (so supports/orientation are identical). Logan printed it from history on the printer and changed exposure there; recorded as 1.8 s, 27 s x 2 bottom on his statement, not from the file. Result: Sajan and Jirelle no issues; Seoni's finest weapon protrusion broke off during support removal, which her Dragon print did not.
Neither Fast plate has reached Brian.

THINGS TO CHECK WITH LOGAN
1. Your note says straight Fast calibrates at 1.9 s; the ledger has 1.8 s on both Fast plates, and 1.9 s on the Space Grey 8K Standard plates. One may be mislabelled, or 1.8 s may be a later setting - the ledger takes the file or Logan's statement, so I cannot say which.
2. Fast plates used 2 bottom layers; the Dragon plates used 5. Your plan raises bottom exposure but not layer count.
3. The Seoni breakage is one sample; do not read it as a trend yet.

BASE-FLARE DATA (Dragon, 30 um, flat on plate): bottom exposure 27/18/12 s gave 25.32/25.20/25.12 mm on a 24.58 mm base, linear at 0.0133 mm per second; 8 s failed to adhere. Floor is between 8 and 12 s. This is Dragon only and will not transfer to the blend. Details in CLAUDE.md under 'Flat on the plate'.

STATE: Logan has put a 10x 25 mm base plate on hold (a 50 um slice, 27 s bottom, Gray 8K Std 50um profile, with deburr variants in bases/) while the blend is tested.

If you log blend test prints in the ledger, send a request and I will record the plate from the file. The ledger takes its resin from the slice's profile name, so the profile Logan slices with must name the blend.
